mechanism: Ginseng may induce CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 enzymes, potentially reducing sodium valproate levels; additionally, ginseng has antiplatelet properties that may increase bleeding risk when combined with valproate's effects on hemostasis.
action: Monitor valproate therapeutic levels and seizure control; counsel patient to maintain consistent ginseng intake and report any unusual bleeding or loss of seizure control.
